name: How long does a typical sliding glass door replacement take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical sliding glass door replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard sliding glass door replacement typically takes one to two days from start to finish. This timeline includes removing the old door, preparing the opening, installing the new door, sealing it properly, and finishing the interior and exterior trim. More complex installations, such as those requiring structural modifications or involving custom-sized doors, may extend the project duration. We strive to minimize disruption and complete the work efficiently.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most replacements take one to two days, covering removal, installation, sealing, and trim work. Complex projects may take longer.
